LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.0.label: Ember Furnace
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.0.descrip: Retains original burning, heat aura, health and awakening. New branches count only your original HexBurn pulses that actually damage a standing enemy, not secondary damage or other burn sources. Progression stays with the relic.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.1.label: Kindled Flare
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.1.descrip: Two consecutive damaging original burn pulses on the same enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 50 damage, once per 8 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.2.label: Furnace Mantle
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.2.descrip: Two consecutive damaging original burn pulses on the same enemy, at most 3 seconds apart, grant a 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Changing targets resets the count. Fully absorbed pulses do not count. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.3.label: Reclaimed Heat
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.3.descrip: After Kindled Flare actually deals its bonus damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Cannot restore permanent scars or missing parts. Prevented bonus damage grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.4.label: Flare Shelter
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.4.descrip: After Kindled Flare actually deals bonus damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.5.label: Hearth Aid
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.5.descrip: Under the same burn condition as Furnace Mantle, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Counts and resolves independently; does not heal you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.6.label: Banked Ember
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Embertide.nodes.6.descrip: Under the same burn condition as Furnace Mantle, independently store one ember for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 damage. One ember maximum; burn pulses cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.
